name: radar-chart
title: Radar chart
description: A React radar chart (spider chart) to compare a few profiles across the same measures, with collision-free axis labels and keyboard reading. Animated, MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Radar chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/radar-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { RadarChart } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/radar-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
